raw:
I remember a neighbor being snowed in after a storm. There was a deep drift against her front steps, and I felt for her, thinking about having all that snow in the way just to get out of the house.

I shoveled a path to her gate. What was on my mind was making it a little easier for her—something I could actually do, rather than just feel bad about her being snowed in. That’s the occasion that comes to mind.
